## Start a conversation

We welcome thoughtful questions about research collaborations, opportunities to join the lab, funding and proposal development, and diagnostic or computational projects.

**Dr. Ricardo I. Alcalá Briseño**\
Assistant Professor of Viral Ecology\
Department of Plant Pathology and Environmental Microbiology\
The Pennsylvania State University

**Office:** 101 Buckhout Laboratory\
**Email:** [ria5282@psu.edu](mailto:ria5282@psu.edu)

Use the form to send a message directly to the lab. Your email application will not open, and the page will confirm when the message has been delivered.
:::

::: {.contact-panel}
```{=html}
<form id="lab-contact-form" class="contact-form" action="https://formspree.io/f/mjybdzgy" method="POST">
  <input id="contact-email-subject" type="hidden" name="_subject" value="New Briseño Lab website inquiry">
  <label class="form-honeypot" aria-hidden="true">Leave this field empty
    <input type="text" name="_gotcha" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off">
  </label>

  <fieldset>
    <legend>What would you like to discuss?</legend>
    <div class="contact-topics">
      <label><input type="radio" name="topic" value="Research collaboration" checked> <span><strong>Research</strong><small>Projects and collaboration</small></span></label>
      <label><input type="radio" name="topic" value="Joining the lab"> <span><strong>Joining us</strong><small>Student and researcher opportunities</small></span></label>
      <label><input type="radio" name="topic" value="Funding and proposals"> <span><strong>Funding</strong><small>Grants and proposal partnerships</small></span></label>
      <label><input type="radio" name="topic" value="Diagnostics, data, and software"> <span><strong>Diagnostics &amp; data</strong><small>Samples, analysis, and software</small></span></label>
    </div>
  </fieldset>

  <div class="form-row">
    <label for="contact-name">Name <span aria-hidden="true">*</span>
      <input id="contact-name" name="name" type="text" autocomplete="name" required>
    </label>
    <label for="contact-email">Email <span aria-hidden="true">*</span>
      <input id="contact-email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" required>
    </label>
  </div>

  <label for="contact-affiliation">Institution or organization
    <input id="contact-affiliation" name="affiliation" type="text" autocomplete="organization">
  </label>

  <label for="contact-subject">Short subject <span aria-hidden="true">*</span>
    <input id="contact-subject" name="subject" type="text" required placeholder="What would you like to discuss?">
  </label>

  <label for="contact-message">Message <span aria-hidden="true">*</span>
    <textarea id="contact-message" name="message" rows="7" required placeholder="Please include the context, your question, and any relevant timeline."></textarea>
  </label>

  <button id="contact-submit" type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Send message</button>
  <p class="form-help">Required fields are marked with an asterisk.</p>
  <div id="form-status" class="form-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
</form>
```
:::

:::

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const form = document.getElementById("lab-contact-form");
  if (!form) return;

  const button = document.getElementById("contact-submit");
  const status = document.getElementById("form-status");
  const emailSubject = document.getElementById("contact-email-subject");

  form.addEventListener("submit", async function (event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!form.reportValidity()) return;

    const data = new FormData(form);
    const topic = data.get("topic") || "Website inquiry";
    emailSubject.value = `[${topic}] ${data.get("subject")}`;

    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = "Sending…";
    status.className = "form-status";
    status.setAttribute("role", "status");
    status.textContent = "Sending your message securely…";

    try {
      const response = await fetch(form.action, {
        method: "POST",
        body: new FormData(form),
        headers: { "Accept": "application/json" }
      });

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Submission failed");

      form.reset();
      status.className = "form-status is-success";
      status.textContent = "Thank you—your message was sent to the Briseño Lab.";
      button.textContent = "Send another message";
    } catch (error) {
      status.className = "form-status is-error";
      status.setAttribute("role", "alert");
      status.textContent = "The message could not be sent. Please try again, or email ria5282@psu.edu directly.";
      button.textContent = "Try again";
    } finally {
      button.disabled = false;
    }
  });
});
</script>
```

::: {.contact-note}
## Before sending samples or large files

Please email first with a short description of the material, the biological question, and any known diagnostic history. Do not send regulated biological material or confidential data until appropriate arrangements have been confirmed.
:::
